tuition_year_of_rates: NOT STATED ON PAGE — Deusto postgraduate fee table gives no academic year; treat the year as unverified

application_window_2027: NOT FOUND — the Deusto programme page displayed 'Admission process closed' on 2026-08-25 and publishes no dated application window for any year.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND — Deusto routes enquiries through a web form (/en/home/contact) and a 'Request interview' Salesforce form; no email published.

S1 complementary: Business Management 6, Data and Descriptive Statistics 6, Probability and Inferential Statistics 6. S2 compulsory: Big Data and Internet Technologies 3, Deep Learning 3, Ethics Challenges and Risk/Cybersecurity 4, On the Edge 3, Unstructured Data Analysis 3. S2 electives: Entrepreneurship 3, Finance Analytics 3, Logistics & Supply Chain Data Analytics 3, Marketing Analytics 3. Final Master's Dissertation 6.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Deusto Business School — AACSB and AMBA accredited (institution-level claim on the Deusto site).
industry_links: 'Practical training in business analysis' with a professional experience component (Deusto overview page). No named partner companies published.
thesis_or_internship: Final Master's Dissertation 6 ECTS (study plan). RUCT records 0 ECTS prácticas and 6 ECTS TFM.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos para los Negocios / Master of Science in Business Analytics por la Universidad Ramón Llull
programme_name_en: Master's in Business Analytics (MSc in Business Analytics)
language_of_instruction: 'English' — with 'Optional classes in Spanish, German, French, and Mandarin Chinese' (Esade programme page). The Esade page does not publish a Spanish-language 'idioma de impartición' statement; the RUCT register does not record language.
language_requirement: 'Proficiency in English is a must.' TOEFL iBT 100 / IELTS Academic 7.0 / Cambridge CAE B+ / Duolingo +130. Waived if the bachelor's was taught entirely in English (minimum 120 ECTS).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2027-28 — page heading is verbatim 'MSc Tuition Fees 2027-2028 / One year program / €39.000'
non_eu_surcharge: NO — a single flat rate. The Esade Fees & Financing page publishes one figure (€39.000) for all one-year MSc programmes with no EU/non-EU differentiation anywhere on the page. For a non-EU candidate this is the headline price, unlike a Spanish public university.
entry_requirements: 'An undergraduate degree that entitles you to undertake postgraduate studies'; for Business Analytics specifically 'undergraduate degree in business administration or other subjects with a strong scientific or technical foundation, such as engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, bioinformatics, computer programming, computer science, or information systems'. Plus Esade Admission Test (TAE), GMAT or GRE; two recommendation letters; mandatory interview.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT YES — 'engineering' and 'computer programming, computer science' are named in the accepted-background list on the admissions page.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos is null for 4316137). At applicant level Esade runs a pre-programme August–September module 'for those without an academic background in business' rather than formal complementos de formación.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND — no reconocimiento de créditos / advanced-standing statement on the overview, academics, admissions or fees pages.
application_window_2027: CONFLICT — nine rolling deadlines published: 1 Oct 2026, 19 Nov 2026, 14 Jan 2027, 18 Feb 2027, 18 Mar 2027, 22 Apr 2027, 13 May 2027, 3 Jun 2027, 1 Jul 2027. The sentence immediately above this table reads 'Missed the deadlines but still want to join our September 2026 MSc intake?' — which cannot be the intake these 2026-27 dates feed. The overview page states 'Start date: September 2027' and the fees page is headed '2027-2028', so this schedule most plausibly serves the September 2027 intake, but Esade's own page contradicts itself and I have NOT resolved it.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES (implied) — 'Apply early by completing our online application form... competition for places is intense'; and non-EU visa applicants are told to apply for the visa 'at least 60 days before the program begins'.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND — no email published on the admissions page; contact is via the international admissions team form.
curriculum_summary: Pre-programme Aug–Sep 2026 for non-business backgrounds. Official Program Start 14 September 2026 (dates as published for the current cycle). Term 1 Foundations 20 ECTS: Business in Society 4, Cloud Computing 4, Artificial Intelligence I 4, Python for Data Science 4, Competing with Artificial Intelligence & Cloud 4. Study Tours & Skill Seminars 5 ECTS. Term 2 Specialised Courses 15 ECTS: Artificial Intelligence II 3, Cloud Platforms – AWS 3, Data Analytics with R 3, Prototyping with Data and AI 3, Thinking with Data 3. Capstone Project 4 ECTS. Term 3 Electives 10 ECTS.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Esade Sant Cugat Campus; AWS certificate track (Amazon Web Services Certificate page).
industry_links: Optional internship 3–6 months worldwide; international study tours; AWS certification.
thesis_or_internship: Capstone Project 4 ECTS; optional internship 3–6 months. RUCT records 6 ECTS TFM and 0 ECTS prácticas.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Analítica de Negocio / Master in Business Analytics por la IE Universidad (registered title)
programme_name_en: Master in Business Analytics and Data Science (marketed title)
institution: IE University — IE School of Science and Technology
autonomous_community: Madrid (taught); IE Universidad is registered in Castilla y León
language_of_instruction: 'language: English' — stated in the programme fact bar on IE's own page. IE publishes no Spanish 'idioma de impartición' plan document.
language_requirement: TOEFL minimum 100 (105 recommended), IELTS minimum 7 (7.5 recommended), Duolingo minimum 130, or Cambridge Advanced. Waived for native speakers, an undergraduate degree taken in English, 2+ years living and working in an English-speaking country, or extensive professional experience in English. Certificates valid 2 years.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026 intakes — the fee block is labelled verbatim 'TUITION 43,000€*' above 'Part-Time February 2026 Intake' and 'Full-Time April & September 2026 Intakes'. NO 2027 figure is published; IE states elsewhere that tuition is reviewed yearly.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — one flat tuition for everyone. IE publishes a single figure with no EU/non-EU differentiation; the only non-EU-specific content is visa advice ('If you are non-EU candidate, we encourage you to confirm your place and begin your visa process as early as possible'). For a Tunisian candidate the headline €43,000 is the real price.
entry_requirements: Bachelor degree from an accredited university; official transcripts (certified translation into English or Spanish); 1-page CV; personal statement; two references; English certificate; passport; €150 application fee. Then an admissions test (ieGAT, GMAT or GRE), a Kira/online assessment of three live questions (two video, one written), and a personal interview.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT YES (by inclusion) — 'The Master in Business Analytics & Data Science welcomes students from a wide range of academic and professional backgrounds... students without a tech background can successfully develop the skills'. No degree-field restriction is published, so an engineering degree is well inside the profile.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos is null for 4317722). IE publishes no complementos de formación; instead a self-paced 'Pre-program Foundations Week' covering computational thinking, Python, GitHub, Linux, Excel and AI basics, which carries no stated ECTS.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND — no reconocimiento de créditos or advanced-standing provision published on the programme, study-plan or admissions-and-fees pages.
application_window_2027: ROLLING, NO DEADLINE — verbatim: 'There is no application deadline, as we operate a rolling admissions process and accept applications throughout the year. However, places are limited and awarded on a first-come, first-served basis... On average, the admissions process takes between 4 and 6 weeks'. Intake start dates published: 2026-2027 full-time Fall intake starts 21 September; 2027 full-time Spring intake starts 20 April; 2027 part-time intake starts 9 February. A September 2027 start date is NOT yet published.
application_rounds: Rolling admissions — no rounds. Intakes: February | April | September.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — verbatim: 'If you are non-EU candidate, we encourage you to confirm your place and begin your visa process as early as possible. Keep in mind that depending on your region, visa-related deadlines may apply.'
admissions_contact_email: student.services@ie.edu (named on the admissions & fees page for non-EU/visa questions)
curriculum_summary: 11 months full-time (17 months part-time). Pre-program Foundations Week, then Core Period Terms 1–2 (Statistics for Data Science, Big Data & AI, SQL Based Data Architectures, etc.), Elective Period Term 3 with a chosen concentration, plus Capstone Projects, exchanges and internships. Concentrations: Healthcare & Biotechnology; Retail, Luxury & E-Commerce; Sports, Media & Entertainment; Smart Manufacturing & Automation; Advanced AI; Tech Consulting & Data Strategy; Tech Entrepreneurship; Aerospace Technology.
notable_faculty_or_lab: IE School of Science and Technology; Venture Lab; Impact Xcelerator; IEX Labs.
industry_links: Partnerships named on the page: Google, AWS, Microsoft, Accenture, IBM, BMC Helix, Bulgari, Repsol, Iberdrola, BCG, Ryanair, United Nations. Alumni employers named: Google, Renault, EY, KPMG, Sony, Meta.
thesis_or_internship: Capstone Project plus internships/hackathons/Venture Labs. RUCT records 0 ECTS prácticas and 6 ECTS TFM.
